description: Clear the local taste profile (~/.muggle-ai/taste/profile.json), or only one project's section when projectId is given. A full clear also removes ~/.muggle-ai/taste/profile.md and the upload state. The signal journal and any uploaded profile are untouched; delete the uploaded one with muggle-remote-taste-profile-delete.

projectId.description: Clear only this project's section; omit to clear the whole profile.

name: muggle-local-taste-profile-clear
